title: WIRED World Fair 2026
gist: This is a WIRED tag/index page for the WIRED World Fair 2026 in Miami (November 4) containing only headlines and bylines, not an article; it lists sessions with Alexis Ohanian, Hugging Face's CEO, Colossal CEO Ben Lamm, Alex Gibney and political influencers. Signal is limited to which topics the event featured: AI risk, AI-and-social-media, Big Tech accountability and Musk.

insights.claim: WIRED World Fair 2026 took place in Miami on November 4, with coverage spanning AI, social media, Big Tech litigation, biotech and politics.
insights.speaker: Condé Nast
insights.so_what: Identifies the source event for a cluster of tech-leader statements worth tracking.

insights.claim: Featured sessions included Hugging Face's CEO saying his P(doom) is 'close to zero' and the Reddit founder saying building social media apps is 'not cool anymore'.
insights.speaker: Condé Nast
insights.so_what: Points to leader commentary on AI risk and the social media investment cycle covered in separate articles.

insights.claim: The event also highlighted Big Tech accountability themes, including a lawyer 'beating the tar out of' Big Tech in court and director Alex Gibney asking whether Democrats can now hold Elon Musk accountable.
insights.speaker: Condé Nast
insights.so_what: Indicates rising focus on litigation and political accountability risk for Big Tech and Musk.

insights.claim: Colossal CEO Ben Lamm discussed working with the Trump administration, framed as not putting 'your head in the sand for 4 years'.
insights.speaker: Condé Nast
insights.so_what: Shows biotech startups pragmatically engaging the administration rather than opposing it.
